queries.sql: SELECT `categorias`.*, COUNT(DISTINCT i1.id_instalacion) AS instalaciones_principal, COUNT(DISTINCT i2.id_instalacion) AS instalaciones_secundaria, COUNT(DISTINCT i1.id_instalacion) + COUNT(DISTINCT i2.id_instalacion) AS total_instalaciones FROM `categorias` LEFT JOIN `instalaciones` `i1` ON `i1`.`categoria_principal` = `categorias`.`id_categoria` LEFT JOIN `instalaciones` `i2` ON `i2`.`categoria_opcional1` = `categorias`.`id_categoria` GROUP BY `categorias`.`id_categoria`
